snippet.title: A Webbing Journey - Early Access Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🕷️ A Webbing Journey is swinging out on Steam Early Access! 🕸️
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073910/A_Webbing_Journey

We’re thrilled to finally announce that A Webbing Journey is available on Steam! After years of love, chaos, and a whole lot of web-slinging, our cozy little spider adventure is ready for you to play.

In A Webbing Journey, you play as Silky, a charming little spider helping your human roommates around their house by solving oversized tasks, building webs, and getting into all sorts of physics-based mischief.

✨ Explore handcrafted rooms
🕸️ Build creative web structures
🎩 Unlock hats, web colors, and more
🐞 Complete quirky tasks (and cause a little chaos along the way)

This trailer gives you a glimpse at what’s waiting for you in Early Access—and there’s plenty more to come!

💬 Let us know in the comments what you’re most excited about!
